mapper.select: SELECT php.id, php.product_basic_info_uuid AS productBasicInfoUuid, php.reference_price AS referencePrice, php.supplier_customer_id AS supplierCustomerId, c.customer_name AS supplier, php.create_time AS createTime, php.create_user AS createUser FROM product_history_price php LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON php.supplier_customer_id = c.uuid ORDER BY php.create_time DESC, php.id DESC

SELECT php.id, php.product_basic_info_uuid AS productBasicInfoUuid, php.reference_price AS referencePrice, php.supplier_customer_id AS supplierCustomerId, c.customer_name AS supplier, php.create_time AS createTime, php.create_user AS createUser FROM product_history_price php LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON php.supplier_customer_id = c.uuid WHERE php.id = #{id}

SELECT php.id, php.product_basic_info_uuid AS productBasicInfoUuid, php.reference_price AS referencePrice, php.supplier_customer_id AS supplierCustomerId, c.customer_name AS supplier, php.create_time AS createTime, php.create_user AS createUser FROM product_history_price php LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON php.supplier_customer_id = c.uuid WHERE php.product_basic_info_uuid = #{productUuid} ORDER BY php.create_time DESC, php.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_history_price ( product_basic_info_uuid, reference_price, supplier_customer_id, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{productBasicInfoUuid}, #{referencePrice}, #{supplierCustomerId}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
